newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Corporate News in Brief - Acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Corporate News in Brief - Acquisitions.

text.p: UTI Energy Corp said it agreed to buy the contract drilling division of Quarles Drilling Inc of Tulsa, Oklahoma for about $16.2 million in cash and stock.
The deal should close within the next few weeks and will increase the total drilling rigs owned by UTI to 74, UTI said.
KING OF PRUSSIA, Pa., Jan 21 (Reuter) - Home Health Corp of America Inc said it agreed to buy the stock of Nahatan Drug Inc of Canton, Massachusetts.

Nahatan provides durable medical equipment and respiratory therapy service to homebound patients in Massachusetts, Rhode Island, New Hampshire and Maine and has annual net revenues of about $9.0 million, Home Health Corp said.
BELLE CHASSE, La., Jan 21 (Reuter) - Superior Energy Services Inc said it agreed in principal to buy Concentric Pipe & Tool Rentals of Houma, Louisiana.

Superior said it will pay $2.8 million in cash and notes together with 1,500,000 shares of Superior common stock for Concentric, an oil field rental tool company with operating offices in Houma and Lafayette, Louisiana.
